newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan passes on 30,000 tonnes raw sugar tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan passes on 30,000 tonnes raw sugar tender.

text.p: State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp passed on a 30,000-tonne raw sugar shipment due to high bid prices at a tender in New York City, company officials said on Wednesday.
A Taiwan Sugar official declined to disclose prices for the invitation-only tender.
The shipment was slated for June 5 to June 20 arrival to Taiwan.
The shipment would be re-tendered on May 6 in New York city with same specifications, the official said.
